LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Onigiri.label: onigiri
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Onigiri.description: Triangles of pressed rice wrapped in seaweed, with a sour plum in the middle. Keeps well on the road.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Miso.label: miso soup
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Miso.description: A lacquered bowl of fermented bean broth with tofu and spring onion. Every Yamato morning starts with one.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Mochi.label: mochi
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Mochi.description: Pounded sweet rice cakes in three colours on a skewer, made for the tea ceremony and the new year. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
